kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتمر (form VIII)
# أَجْتَمِرُ (ʔajtamiru) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# أَجْتَمِرَ (ʔajtamira) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.mi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
# أَجْتَمِرْ (ʔajtamir) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.mir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِجْتَمَرَ (ijtamara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
